seeds.note: How does this relate to the current stage of life that I am in. I think the lesson that I need to learn is better management, even when I had more I didn’t manage it. Well, it was just easier to pay my bills because my bills were less and I had more now that my bills are more and I have less better management is the only thing that will remove the deeper levels of stress and strain that I feel. Maybe the lesson that Yahweh is teaching me in this season is manage well cause I haven’t managed any of the things in my hand too well whether that be money work passion projects Chapel see I haven’t managed to well that’s the lesson of the season.
